description: This file defines the Ext.ux.grid.filter.Filter class, an abstract base class for grid filter implementations in Ext JS 3.3.0. It includes configuration options, event handling, and template methods for subclasses.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.Filter
classes.description: An abstract base class for grid filters, providing event handling, configuration, and template methods for subclasses.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the filter by removing event listeners and menus.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Template method for initializing the filter; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Template method to get the filter's value; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Template method to set the filter's value; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: isActivatable
methods.description: Returns true if the filter can be activated; default implementation returns true.

methods.name: getSerialArgs
methods.description: Template method to get serialized filter data for server transmission.

methods.name: validateRecord
methods.description: Validates a data record against the filter; default returns true.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns serialized filter data and fires 'serialize' event.

methods.name: fireUpdate
methods.description: Fires 'update' event if filter is active and updates active state.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the filter's active state and fires 'activate' or 'deactivate' events.
